facts.fact: The Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation says MauPass, Mauritius's digital ID platform, lets every citizen log in securely to government platforms.
The ministry says through MauPass citizens can log in to government platforms, apply for online certificates and renew the Motor Vehicle License.

systems.owner: Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation

MUS.note: Document states nothing the study asks.
The only feedback channel is an email address for MauPass users' ideas, not a channel for complaints about public services.
